company.name: Ledgerline
company.tagline: Close the books in a day, not a fortnight.

problem.headline: Month-end close is still manual
problem.summary: Finance teams reconcile across systems that were never designed to agree with each other.

points.text: The median mid-market close takes 11 working days.
Two-thirds of reconciliation work is copying between systems.
Errors surface after reporting, when they are most expensive.

solution.headline: A ledger that reconciles itself
solution.summary: Ledgerline ingests every source system, matches entries continuously, and surfaces only the exceptions a human needs to judge.

capabilities.name: Continuous matching
capabilities.detail: entries reconcile as they arrive, not at period end

capabilities.name: Exception queues
capabilities.detail: reviewers see the 2% that need judgement

capabilities.name: Audit trail
capabilities.detail: every match is explainable and reversible

market.headline: Every company with more than one system of record
market.note: Mid-market finance software, excluding enterprise ERP suites and single-entity bookkeeping tools.

traction.headline: Growing through finance teams that tell each other

model.milestonesHeadline: What the next three quarters buy

milestones.title: Ship the reconciliation API
milestones.detail: Open the matching engine to customers who want to drive it from their own systems rather than our UI.

milestones.title: SOC 2 Type II
milestones.detail: Complete the observation window and publish the report; the largest blocker in enterprise deals.

milestones.title: Multi-entity consolidation
milestones.detail: Support groups closing several entities at once, in different currencies and jurisdictions.
